meta.pooled_row_rule: a row built from several T6 rows shows their median at medium confidence or better; dissent ≥ 0.33 → ±; confidence = weakest setting row
meta.caution: chip outline when the row lists measured harm for some adopters
meta.locus: where the effect lands: on-farm · landscape / downstream · both · public good (schema/lookups/effect_locus.csv + scorecard_locus.csv)
meta.directness: direct = at least half the row's units measured the outcome itself; indirect = mostly a stand-in or a mechanism (income for poverty, canopy cooling for heat, runoff for flood)
